trail.text: Flagged window shows train-service strain — I'm digging in to trace the failure source.
Train-service shows the strongest distress — now I'll check if its callers are victims or culprits.
Callers show only latency with no resource issues — pointing to train-service as the origin. Now I'll verify the timing.
Timing points to train-service failing first — now I'll rule out infrastructure causes before finalizing.

causes.reasoning: Memory working set exploded from ~169MB to ~878MB with RSS and system CPU surging, driving p99 latency up while request rate fell, indicating an internal memory blowup not load.
Only tail latency spiked with no memory or CPU change, consistent with blocking on downstream train-service as a victim.
Sharp p99/p95 latency rise with stable memory and CPU, indicating victim of train-service slowdown.
Large latency increase without resource deviation, matching downstream dependency waiting on train-service.
Host disk writes surged 2.5 to 104 with no other hosts affected, likely co-located symptom of train-service memory pressure and page activity.
